basics.name: Michael Färber
basics.label: Full Professor (W3)
basics.summary: Since April 2024, I have been a W3 Full Professor leading the Scalable Software Architectures for Data Analytics research group at the AI Center ScaDS.AI (TU Dresden). My research combines Natural Language Processing, Knowledge Representation, and Machine Learning, with a particular focus on neurosymbolic AI and explainable AI. I have published more than 100 publications, have secured significant third-party funding, and am deeply engaged in academic teaching.
